title: Embedding: OpenAI adapter (pattern leader)
description:
Implement OpenAI embedding provider adapter from docs/plans/01-ai-core.add01.md §8.1.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Key deliverables:
- OpenAI embedding adapter struct (separate from chat provider — seam review fix)
- API ID: "openai-embeddings"
- POST {baseUrl}/embeddings endpoint
- Request mapping: req.Texts → input, req.Dimensions → dimensions, req.Encoding → encoding_format, TaskType ignored
- Response mapping: data[i].embedding → Embedding.Values, data[i].index → Embedding.Index, usage.total_tokens → Usage.Tokens
- HTTP client with auth header, error handling (429/400/500), timeout
- OpenAI-compatible endpoint support (Voyage, vLLM, Ollama) via BaseURL override
- RegisterEmbeddingProvider integration
- Unit tests with mock HTTP server

This is the pattern leader — Google and Cohere adapters follow this pattern.
